sentences.japanese: 丘の向こう側に美しい谷がある。
sentences.english: A beautiful valley lies behind the hill.
A man's life has its ups and downs.

sentences.japanese: 一歩誤るとせんじんの谷だ。
sentences.english: One step further, and you will fall into an abyss.

sentences.japanese: その埃っぽい小道は谷へと下って行く。
sentences.english: The dusty track descends to a valley.

sentences.japanese: その谷で金が見つかったといううわさがある。
sentences.english: There is a rumor that gold has been found in the valley.
